# RC Lighting

> > Professional LED lighting manufacturer specializing in architectural, landscape, and outdoor lighting solutions with IP68/IP66 waterproof products.

RC Lighting (R&C Lighting) is a China-based LED lighting manufacturer offering commercial-grade spotlights, wall washers, flood lights, and underwater lighting featuring Cree, Osram, and Bridgelux LED components. The company specializes in customizable, low-voltage solutions for landscape, architectural, and bridge lighting applications.

## Key Topics

- RC Lighting / R&C Lighting
- LED spotlights and flood lights
- Landscape lighting
- Architectural lighting
- IP68 waterproof lighting
- IP66 rated products
- Low voltage LED systems
- Cree, Osram, Bridgelux LEDs
- COB LED technology
- Customizable beam angles
- Underwater/submersible lighting
- Wall washer fixtures
- Bridge lighting solutions
- China LED manufacturer
- Commercial and accent lighting
